Urticating_Barbed_Hairs.description: The tarantula's exoskeleton bristles with barbed hairs that can be released in a cloud, each hair a conduit for a venomous irritant that reduces the target's charisma and can induce a paralyzing fear, perfect for ensnaring prey or foes.

Sclerotized_Chitin_Plates.description: Layered in thick, black chitin, the sclerotized plates form an impenetrable exoskeleton that grants formidable natural armor, each segment interlocking like a scorpion's tail, though at the cost of increasing visibility and reducing the ability to move silently through shadowy terrains.

Cryptic_Crab_Spider_Mimicry.description: This creature weaves the uncanny traits of a crab and a spider into a seamless exoskeleton, granting it unparalleled stealth as it skitters through shadows, its chitinous shell shifting colors to match the surroundings, and sharp eyes always on the lookout for the perfect moment to strike or hide.

Iridescent_Jumping_Scale_Dust.description: The Iridescent Jumping Scale Dust, a fine powder shed by the elusive and deadly iridescent arachnid, grants the wearer an ethereal, shimmering exoskeleton that boosts charisma and evasion, imbuing them with the ability to intimidate foes and dance around danger with unnatural grace.

Hydrophobic_Velvet_Coating.description: This arachnid's exoskeleton is covered in a rare hydrophobic velvet coating, allowing it to glide effortlessly over water with increased speed and agility, while also granting it the ability to slip away from predators with ease.

Heavily_Spiked_Abdomen_Shell.description: This arachnid's abdomen is encased in an exoskeleton densely covered with sharp, venomous spikes, providing formidable natural armor while inflicting grievous wounds on any attacker foolish enough to strike it.

Glandular_Glue_Secreting_Pores.description: Embedded within the arachnid's chitinous exoskeleton, these specialized pores secrete a sticky, adhesive substance that not only bolsters the creature's natural armor but also grants it the ability to grapple and immobilize its prey with ruthless efficiency.

Fleshy_Parasitic_Engorgement_Sac.description: This gelatinous sac, resembling a grotesque fusion of arachnid and tick, engorges and distends the host’s flesh, granting a surprising boost to constitution but at the cost of agility, as the creature’s movements become sluggish and encumbered by the parasitic mass’s elasticity and exoskeletal protrusions.

Necrotic_Detritus_Armor.description: Woven from the desiccated remains of ancient arachnids and dark necrotic energy, the Necrotic_Detritus_Armor forms a chitinous exoskeleton that not only grants unparalleled stealth capabilities by blending into the shadows and debris but also imposes a chilling aura that repels the living, reducing their natural charisma towards the wearer.

Subterranean_Pigmentless_Chitin.description: This pale, chitinous exoskeleton, lacking any natural pigmentation, grants its bearer enhanced stealth capabilities at the cost of a slight decrease in constitution, perfectly adapted for the silent, burrowing predator of the darkest subterranean realms.
